title.tr: Beyaz ve mavi boyalı verandalı oyun evi
title.en: Playhouse with a veranda, painted white and blue

alt.tr: Beyaz boyalı, mavi kapı ve pencere kepenkli, ahşap verandası olan çocuk oyun evi
alt.en: Children's playhouse painted white with a blue door and window shutters and a timber veranda

caption.tr: Kapıda kalp biçimli bir oyuk var, pencerelerin kepenkleri mavi. Veranda beyaz korkuluklu, zemini ahşap tahtalı.
caption.en: The door has a heart-shaped cut-out and the window shutters are blue. The veranda has a white railing and a boarded timber floor.
